title: Quietly Tender Venezuelan Turkey Neck Dumplings
description: A kid-friendly Venezuelan dish featuring tender turkey neck and dumplings, made with herbal flavors and suitable for diabetic diets. This dish is a hearty and comforting meal option.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the turkey neck, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper to the pot, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour, or until the turkey is tender.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornmeal, and chopped cilantro.
Gradually add the hot broth from the pot to the bowl, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 5 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and wrap around a piece of the cooked turkey neck.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with additional chopped cilantro if desired.
